title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds

reports.title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds

summary:
U.S. officials say Russia has been running covert online disinformation operations aimed at undermining public confidence in the November midterm elections. Classified intelligence assessments found the Kremlin authorized a digital influence campaign to spread content on social media and inflame domestic divisions. The officials said there is no evidence Russia tried to compromise voting machines or the actual voting process. Some experts have spotted recent social media campaigns using artificial intelligence to create fake videos of Hollywood celebrities discussing battleground Senate races.

The effort appears smaller and less coordinated than some previous Russian operations, and officials believe Moscow is less focused on midterms than presidential races, partly because of the war in Ukraine. Since 2016, Russia has attempted influence in every federal election cycle. The article does not say what specific actions the U.S. will take next. It notes President Trump has separately claimed voting systems have severe vulnerabilities, but the article does not connect those claims to the Russian campaign.
